query: I was walking my golden retriever this morning and he chased a squirrel right into a patch of dandelions, I spent ten minutes brushing burrs out of his fur after we got home. Then I stopped by the corner café to pick up an iced latte, and they accidentally added extra vanilla syrup, it turned out way sweeter than I usually like but it was still pretty good. Oh, and I just remembered I need to pick up a new dog toy on my way home tomorrow because he tore up his favorite rubber duck yesterday. Anyway, I’m having an issue with my phone right now—my mobile data isn’t working at all, I got a notification earlier that I’ve used up all my data for the billing cycle and I already have data mode turned off, can you help me figure out what’s going on?
